title: Köy Yerinde Cinayet
author: Belda Öztürk
description: In a quiet seaside village where nothing ever happens, the arrival of the new gendarmerie commander, Pars, stirs mild excitement among the locals. But when the first murder in the village’s history shatters the calm, excitement turns into shock. Determined to solve the case, Commander Balkır—Pars’s former teacher at the academy—steps in to help. As the investigation unfolds, the quirky and colorful villagers complicate every lead, turning the mystery into a delightful puzzle. With a touch of romance, a dash of humor, and a classic whodunit atmosphere, Murder in the Village brings the charm of Richard Osman– style cozy crime to Turkish literature.
